campaigns.title: School Bus for Tamale Children
campaigns.impact: Daily transport for 38 children across the 2026/27 school year.
campaigns.story: Our partner school in Tamale is one bus short. With CHF 25,000 we can lease a bus for the school year and cover fuel and maintenance.

campaigns.title: Emergency Aid · Marrakech Quake
campaigns.impact: Direct shelter and food relief to 80 affected families.
campaigns.story: Working with a local NGO to distribute emergency aid to families displaced by the September quake.

impactStories.title: 38 children riding daily
impactStories.body: First month with the new bus completed. 38 students riding daily; on-time arrivals improved from 64% to 96%.

impactStories.title: Fuel and maintenance under budget
impactStories.body: Operating costs running 12% under projection. Surplus reserved for tire replacement.
